fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 1.93¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,308/t (58th pct of 5 yrs). Desk read: Brazil still sets the tone: the real's slide on fiscal worries keeps Centre-South mills keen to hedge in local-currency terms, and Mar dipped to 17.97 overnight, briefly under 18.02 support, before steadying at ~18.07. Crude's rebound is a small help for the ethanol pull on cane, but not yet enough to change the mill-mix picture.
